Texts.CopyInfoText:
The enemy placement copying lets you directly copy the enemy placement from a reference file if, for some reason, the same settings and seed fail to produce the same placement for different people.

The enemy placement file for each randomization is automatically saved in the 'enemyRandomizerData/refs' folder.

To copy the enemy placement from another person, ask them to send over the latest enemy placement text file from that folder and select it with 'Copy enemy placement' in the Menu.
Texts.TextConfigHelp:
This window allows you to generate a text representation of the currently selected settings and seed.
After selecting 'Generate from current settings' the text version of the current settings is put into the text field.
You can also paste a config into the text field and select 'Apply to settings' to apply it.

This is useful if you want to get the same enemy configuration as a friend: one of you configures the randomizer, generates the text and sends it to the other person, who pastes it here and applies the settings and seed.

Make sure you also enter a seed before generating this config.
